text.content:
• Auto-dev (board-dry): fixed dead "Sign up free" CTA on /become-a-coach and /start-a-club for signed-in visitors — now a working "Go to CourtConnect" / "Go to Clubs" link instead of a no-op button.
• Pruned orphan pending_<uid> keys from chat read-state (cc_realLastRead) — markRealConvRead skips pending_ ids, old keys cleaned on load.
• 💡 product-idea slot: none built today — session spent clearing the last two P3 backlog bugs; board down to 1 parked item (signup-quiz home venue, needs Lok’s schema call).
• Auto-dev (board-dry bug hunt): onboarding modal now prefills from the existing profile. logout() wipes cc_onboarded, so an existing player logging back in (or on a shared device) was re-shown the setup flow — clicking through Finish overwrote their real country/region/availability with blanks. Now round-trips existing values. New signups unaffected. Deployed + build green.
